features.label: Features
features.title: Everything you need to grow, in one dashboard.
features.subtitle: We start with the essentials and keep adding modules. Anything marked "Coming soon" is not available yet.

projects.title: Projects and accounts
projects.desc: Keep each brand or client in its own project and connect its accounts with each network's official login.

ai.title: AI Studio
ai.desc: Generate images and captions in your brand's style. Everything is labelled as AI-generated and you decide what gets published.

clipper.title: Clipper
clipper.desc: Turn long videos you own the rights to into vertical clips with captions.

calendar.title: Calendar and publishing
calendar.desc: Plan by month, week or list and publish to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube through their official APIs.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.desc: Views, followers and engagement for your own accounts, with your best posting time and best formats.

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.desc: Follow public accounts using data the platforms allow us to query. Estimated figures are labelled as such.

winners.title: Winning products
winners.desc: Dropshipping product ideas from public and official sources, with clear estimated-data notices.

hooks.title: Hook library
hooks.desc: Save and organise the hooks and structures that work for you and reuse them in new scripts.

inbox.title: Unified inbox
inbox.desc: Comments and messages from your accounts in one place, only where an official API exists.

strategy.title: Strategy and roadmap
strategy.desc: Goals, content pillars and a weekly plan that AI suggests and you fine-tune.

shopify.title: Shopify
shopify.desc: Connect your store with the official app to create content from your products.

reports.title: White-label reports
reports.desc: PDF reports with your agency's logo to send to your clients.

team.title: Team and roles
team.desc: Invite your team or clients with role-based permissions and approval flows.

mcp.title: Claude integration (MCP)
mcp.desc: Query your data and prepare drafts from Claude. Publishing always requires your approval.

trust.label: Trust
trust.title: 100% official. No tricks that put your accounts at risk.
trust.subtitle: Kreo is designed to follow each platform's rules from day one.

official.title: Official APIs and OAuth only
official.desc: You connect your accounts with each network's official login. We never ask for your password and we never use unofficial APIs or logged-in scraping.

approve.title: AI suggests, you approve
approve.desc: Nothing is published without your explicit approval. We don't automate likes, follows or comments.

limits.title: Anti-ban limits
limits.desc: We respect each platform's posting limits and add our own safety margins. If something could be a risk, we warn you first.

labels.title: AI content labelled
labels.desc: Everything generated with AI is labelled as such, in Kreo and with each network's labels, as the AI Act and the platforms require.

eu.title: Data in the EU
eu.desc: Your data is hosted on servers in the European Union. You can revoke access to your accounts at any time.

trust.disclaimer: Kreo does not promise virality or specific results. Each platform applies its own community guidelines and makes its own decisions about accounts.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps. You're in control in all of them.

connect.title: Connect
connect.desc: Create a project and link your accounts with the official TikTok, Instagram or YouTube login.

create.title: Create and plan
create.desc: Generate ideas and images with AI or upload your own content. Place it on the calendar at the time you prefer.

approve.title: Approve and measure
approve.desc: Review each post and approve it. It goes out on time and you see its results in your analytics.

pricing.label: Pricing

pricing.subtitle: We're still finalising prices. People on the waitlist will hear about them first.

free.desc: To try Kreo with your own brand.

pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: For creators and brands who post every week.

pricing.creditsNote: AI actions use credits. You'll always see the credit cost before confirming, and credits are never spent without your approval.

safe.q: Is it safe to connect my accounts?
safe.a: Yes. You connect them with each platform's official login (OAuth): we never see or store your password. We only request the permissions each feature needs, and you can revoke access at any time, from Kreo or from the network itself.

permission.q: Do you post without my permission?
permission.a: No. AI can suggest ideas, captions or images, but every post needs your explicit approval before it's scheduled. We don't automate likes, follows or comments either.

data.a: It's hosted on servers in the EU and only used to provide the service. We don't sell it. You'll be able to export it or delete your account whenever you want. Details are in the privacy policy.

dms.q: Can I use it with TikTok direct messages?
dms.a: Not yet. TikTok doesn't offer a public direct-messages API for this use, and Kreo only uses official channels. It will show as "Coming soon" until one exists.

credits.a: They're the unit used to pay for AI actions, such as generating an image. Each plan includes an amount, and you'll always see the credit cost before confirming an action.

results.q: Do you guarantee more followers or viral videos?
results.a: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee that. Kreo helps you create consistently, post at good times and understand your data; results depend on your content and on each platform.

platforms.a: At launch: TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, through their official APIs and subject to their approval. We'll add others when they offer an official channel.

rights.q: Can I upload any video to the Clipper?
rights.a: Only content you own the rights to or have permission to use. We'll ask you to confirm this before processing each video.
